title: המחשב בן 2,000 השנה שנשלה מקרקעית הים
summary: The Antikythera mechanism: Symi sponge divers (1900–01), Stais spots a gear (1902), X-rays and 2005 CT layers; gear ratios (teeth ratio = speed ratio, moon train 64/38×48/24×127/32 = 254/19); the front dial (13.37 sidereal laps vs 12.37 lunations, phase ball, pin-and-slot); the 223-month Saros spiral and the 8-hour shift (Exeligmos); the Metonic 19 y = 235 months shared with the Hebrew calendar (5787 is a leap year); the 2 Aug 2027 eclipse as one Saros after 22 Jul 2009.
